title: [Okizari] Body Jack (Laserdisc Version)
description:
Here's a laserdisc rip of the fourth and last Pink Noise OVA, 1987's *Body Jack: Tanoshii Yuutai Ridatsu* (*Body Jack: Sublime Separation*). Don't get your hopes up for an improvement in video quality over the VHS release. First, this is one of the worst laserdisc masterings ever. Second, the laserdisc version is censored - a four minute scene present on the VHS version is cut. For more information, see [this blog entry](https://collectr.blogspot.com/2021/05/body-jack-laserdisc-version.html).

The plot is barely functional: a high-school boy buys a strange machine from a mad scientist. The machine allows the boy to have an out-of-body experience:

![screencap](https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-a2OJZe-Sse0/YJh8bkLE4sI/AAAAAAAABK0/l1d_7jwiYcoJmJTdRUXG1-aMouZrGeV3QCLcBGAsYHQ/s640/bodyjack.take2_001_38395.png)

Sexcapades ensue. End of story (and of the Pink Noise series).

The staff and crew all used pseudonyms for this one. You'll see why if you watch it.
